exposure: OB Teleflex program participation (hybrid prenatal telemedicine)
cohort: Low-risk patients with a singleton, viable, non-anomalous fetus, and without hypertension requiring medication, who delivered at the study center between October 1, 2021, and September 30, 2022.
finding: Hybrid prenatal telemedicine (OB Teleflex program) did not show a difference in the rate of a composite of adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes compared to standard prenatal care.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the rate of primary cesarean delivery between hybrid prenatal telemedicine participants and those receiving standard care.
